A BigFooty thread quoting The West Australian says he signed an 18-month contract, which runs to the end of 2027. Zero Hanger (https://www.zerohanger.com/afl/players/oliver-francou/) lists him as contracted until 2027, though its search snippet separately showed 2026. Not named in any West Coast 2026 off-season delistings (Hall, Schoenberg, Williams, Barnett, Brockman, Johnston; Cripps retired). No extension found.

events.name: Jack Henderson
events.reporter: Melbourne FC (melbournefc.com.au); corroborated by Kyabram Free Press 26 Sep 2025
events.note: One-year extension for the 2026 season after joining via the 2025 pre-season SSP. The club article is undated, so the date is inferred from the Kyabram Free Press story of 26 Sep 2025 (https://www.kyfreepress.com.au/sport/jack-continues-with-melbourne-demons).

events.name: Jack Henderson
events.note: Told he would not be offered a 2027 contract, alongside Aidan Johnson, Andy Moniz-Wakefield, Riley Onley and Kalani White. Neither the club article nor the AFL.com.au report (https://www.afl.com.au/news/1600513/untried-father-son-tall-kalani-white-among-five-melbourne-demons-cut-after-season-ends) is dated. A forum post listing the five delistings is dated 4 Sep 2026, so that date is an estimate. He has since signed with Geelong Amateur FNC (Bellarine League) for 2027, which is not an AFL contract. The original 2025 SSP signing is omitted because he re-signed.

events.name: Jacob Newton
events.note: Club release says Newton (pick 9, 2025 mid-season rookie draft, from Norwood) extended for a further season until 2026, alongside Tom Cole and Tom McCarthy. Page is undated; 19 Sep 2025 date matches the existing ListTrac record for the same release (September 2025 confirmed by search), so flagged as estimated.

events.name: Jacob Newton
events.note: One-year extension through 2027 announced with Tom Cole and Noah Long; Newton played 3 games in 2026 before a foot injury ended his season. Club release (undated page): https://www.westcoasteagles.com.au/news/2113272/eagles-trio-sign-on. Article dated 26 Aug 2026. No delisting, retirement or trade found.

events.name: Tom Burton
events.note: Overlooked in 2025 draft; train-on at Richmond from Nov 2025, then won final rookie spot via 2026 pre-season supplemental selection period (SSP) on 2 March 2026. Contract length not stated; one year to end of 2026 inferred from the 2027 extension.

events.name: Tom Burton
events.note: One-year (12-month) extension through 2027, reported 21 Oct 2026 after five AFL games in 2026. Zero Hanger 20 Oct 2026 report (richmond-utility-pocket-rocket-sign-one-year-extensions-at-punt-road-184046) had him still uncontracted. No official Richmond release found.

events.name: Luke Beecken
events.note: One-year rookie contract extension to the end of 2025 for the 2024 mid-season rookie draftee (pick 17, drafted 29 May 2024 from Woodville-West Torrens). Zero Hanger page is dated 25 Oct 2024. Club release (undated page): https://www.lions.com.au/news/1683753/lions-re-sign-five-ahead-of-2025. The original mid-season draft contract is skipped because he later re-signed.

events.name: Luke Beecken
events.note: Lions' 'further list changes for 2026' release says Beecken and James Tunstill re-signed for next season. The club page is undated, so the 16 Oct 2025 date comes from earlier ListTrac research that used a BigFooty thread quoting the release. The contract runs to the end of 2026 per the Wikipedia article on Luke Beecken (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luke_Beecken) and Footy Info.

events.name: Luke Beecken
events.note: Brisbane delisted Beecken and Darragh Joyce on 22 Oct 2026 (Zero Hanger, published 22 Oct 2026). The deal expired at the end of 2026 and was not renewed. Danny Daly is quoted as saying he 'has shown strong development and application'. AFL.com.au also covered it: https://www.afl.com.au/news/1634451/brisbane-lions-pair-darragh-joyce-and-luke-beecken-delisted-youngsters-to-be-re-drafted-next-month. Zero Hanger's 2026 delistings roundup lists him as delisted: https://www.zerohanger.com/every-afl-teams-retirements-delistings-in-2026-181873. He played 1 AFL game (R23 2025 v Fremantle). No current deal.

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: Drafted by Geelong at pick 59 in the 2015 national draft; delisted at the end of 2018 without playing a senior game. Exact delisting date not stated in sources, so estimated.

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: Selected at pick 6 in the 2019 NAB AFL Mid-Season Rookie Draft (held on a Monday, inferred to be 27 May 2019; debut 2 June 2019). Rookie contract length not published; end year inferred from the one-year rookie extension that later ran through 2021. This is the entry deal, shown as an anchor for the club move.

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: One-year rookie contract extension for 2021 after 10 games in 2020 including the elimination final. Announced with Jordon Sweet. Club page undated; timing (post-2020 season) from the page content and the related Gardner Sees Green Shoots article (https://www.westernbulldogs.com.au/news/834711/gardner-sees-green-shoots), so date is estimated.

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: Two-year extension to the end of 2023. Club article: https://www.westernbulldogs.com.au/news/962508 (Gardner extends until 2023).

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: Three-year extension to at least the end of 2026, after a 22-game 2022 season. Club article: https://www.westernbulldogs.com.au/news/1268746/gardner-remains-in-red-white-and-blue

events.name: Ryan Gardner
events.note: Told with Lachie McNeil and Nick Coffield he will not be offered a 2027 contract and is delisted. Date from Zero Hanger timestamp (16 Oct 2026): https://www.zerohanger.com/western-bulldogs-delist-trio-as-former-top-10-pick-defender-depart-following-busy-afl-trade-period-183968/. AFL.com.au says 58 games for the Bulldogs (Zero Hanger says 55). No other club signing found, so no event is current.

events.name: Aidan Johnson
events.note: Drafted by Melbourne at pick 68 (second night of 2024 National Draft) from Werribee (VFL); date inferred from article dated 22 Nov 2024 reporting second night. Never re-signed; draft contract is the anchor deal. Length not stated; end of 2026 inferred from Melbourne not offering a 2027 contract.

events.name: Aidan Johnson
events.note: Melbourne informed Johnson (with Henderson, Moniz-Wakefield, Onley, White) he would not be offered a 2027 contract; delisted after 6 AFL games, 3 goals. Club page undated; Zero Hanger article dated 22 Oct 2026 confirms delisting and return to Werribee (VFL) for 2027 (https://www.zerohanger.com/delisted-melbourne-forward-announces-return-home-for-2027-184092). Exact delisting date not found, so date is the earliest confirmed report. No current deal.

events.name: Oscar Ryan
events.note: Extended to the end of 2026 after his first season at West Lakes (with Borlase, Bond, Edwards). Date taken from Zero Hanger's 'Quartet of Crows extend time at West Lakes' listing (13 Sep 2024); BigFooty mirrors it at 16 Sep 2024. Drafted by Adelaide at pick 27 in the 2023 national draft.

events.name: Oscar Ryan
events.note: One-year extension (with Hinge, Dowling, Edwards) after the Crows' semi-final exit left them without 2027 contracts. Zero Hanger's player page lists him contracted until 2027. The end year is inferred from the one-year length. Footywire still shows him out of contract at the end of 2026, which looks stale.

events.name: Hugh Davies
events.note: Two-year extension signed December 2023, to the end of 2026. Month stated by the club site, exact day not given. Drafted at pick 33 in 2022; no AFL games at the time.

events.name: Hugh Davies
events.note: Three-year extension to the end of 2029, announced late July 2026. He was out of contract at the end of 2026. The 27 July date comes from the West Australian report carried by the Albany Advertiser: https://www.albanyadvertiser.com.au/sport/fremantle-dockers/fremantle-dockers-young-gun-murphy-reid-set-to-extend-contract-beyond-2030-as-hugh-davies-re-signs-c-22633945. Wikipedia is consistent with this. No delisting or trade found.

events.name: Judson Clarke
events.note: Signed a two-year extension alongside fellow 2021 draftees Tom Brown and Sam Banks, keeping him at Richmond until the end of 2025 (Richmond FC: 'Teenage Tiger trio sign extensions'). Date from Tigerland Archive.

events.name: Judson Clarke
events.note: Signed on for the 2026 season (a fifth year at the club) while rehabbing from his second ACL injury; Zero Hanger article dated 14 May 2025. Richmond FC: 'Judson Clarke signs Richmond extension'.

events.name: Judson Clarke
events.note: Re-signed for the 2027 season (sixth season at the club) after a third ACL injury; Zero Hanger article dated 21 Oct 2026. Richmond FC: 'Hard running duo earn 2027 contract extensions' (https://www.richmondfc.com.au/news/2154693/hard-running-duo-earn-2027-contract-extensions). Length of one year inferred from the 2027-season wording; the exact term was not stated in either source.

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Re-signed with Gold Coast alongside Macpherson, McLennan and Graham, until end of 2022 with 12 months left on prior deal (Aug 2019; exact day not stated, length inferred). Club confirmation: goldcoastfc.com.au/news/253979/rising-suns-extend-their-stay-until-2022

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Traded Gold Coast to Fremantle with pick 19 and picks in the 60s for future 2nd and 4th round picks (2021 trade period); SEN stamped 7 Oct 2021.

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Fremantle lengthened his existing contract (previously expiring 2022) to smooth out his >$400k 2022 salary; new length/end year not stated in sources.

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Three-year extension to at least end of 2026, announced Tuesday 21 Mar 2023 after Rd 1 loss to St Kilda (dated via Shepparton News 21 Mar 2023; also AFL.com.au news/886850).

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Traded Fremantle to Port Adelaide for pick 103 (2025 trade period, day eight); had requested move to play under Josh Carr.

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Joined Port on a two-year contract (end year 2027 inferred from 2026 start).

events.name: Will Brodie
events.note: Retired after 2026 season following two games for Port; 2027 contract year left unfulfilled. Published 16 Oct 2026; Wikipedia also states retired at end of 2026.

events.name: Jesse Dattoli
events.reporter: Sydney Swans (club site); date per Zero Hanger
events.note: 2024 pick 22 draftee who signed a standard two-year deal (to 2026); Swans announced one-year extensions for Dattoli and Ned Bowman 'until 2027' alongside Sam Wicks' three-year deal. Announcement date taken from Zero Hanger's 13 May 2025 article (https://www.zerohanger.com/transformed-swan-pair-of-first-round-picks-sign-extensions-162234/); the club page itself is undated. AFL.com.au (https://www.afl.com.au/news/1310860/no-rush-for-lachie-swans-start-signings-dons-big-trade-call) previewed the deal beforehand. Zero Hanger player profile lists him contracted to 2027. No trade, delisting or further re-signing found as of late Oct 2026.

events.name: Tom Anastasopoulos
events.note: One-year extension (with Will Lorenz, Mani Liddy, Josh Lai) keeping him at Port Adelaide until at least the end of 2026. Zero Hanger dated 28 Aug 2025; club article https://www.portadelaidefc.com.au/news/1877364/quartet-extended-for-one-more describes it as a one-year extension (club page has no visible date). Original deal: selected at pick 48 in the 2023 national draft (https://www.portadelaidefc.com.au/news/1467856/power-swoop-to-land-anastasopoulos-in-draft), contract length not stated. No 2024 extension found in any source.

events.name: Tom Anastasopoulos
events.note: Told he would not be offered a contract for 2027 (with Ollie Lord), alongside Will Brodie's retirement; page metadata describes the pair as delisted. Zero Hanger dated 16 Oct 2026 and says he never played an AFL game for Port (a Neos Kosmos May 2026 piece reported he was set to debut, but that conflicts). No official club statement found. No event is current as he has left the league's lists for 2027.

events.name: Lachy Dovaston
events.note: Anchor deal: draft contract. Selected by North Melbourne at pick 16 in the 2025 AFL National Draft (night one, 19 Nov 2025) from Eastern Ranges, via a live pick trade with Carlton. Zero Hanger lists 'Contracted Until 2028' and Footywire's North Melbourne contract list shows a 2028 final year (https://www.footywire.com/afl/footy/to-kangaroos). Length of 3 years is derived from the 2025 draft start to 2028 expiry. Exact signing date is not published; the draft date is used. Draft confirmed at https://www.nmfc.com.au/news/1932098/livewire-forward-lachy-dovaston-joins-the-roos-with-pick-no16. No extension, trade, delisting or retirement found across NMFC, AFL.com.au, Zero Hanger, Footywire and SEN searches; still an active North Melbourne player, so the deal is current.

events.name: Noah Roberts-Thomson
events.reporter: Richmond FC (club profile); Zero Hanger; AFL.com.au (draft night two report)
events.note: Drafted by Richmond at pick 54 (Sturt, SANFL) on night two of the 2025 AFL Draft (20 Nov 2025). Richmond's player profile and Zero Hanger both list him as contracted until 2027. No re-signing, trade, delisting or retirement reported as of late Oct 2026; he is not on Zero Hanger's 21 Oct 2026 Richmond delistings/retirements list. Draft date taken from the AFL.com.au night-two report publication date; length and end year inferred from the 'contracted until 2027' listing.

events.name: Alex Dodson
events.note: St Kilda re-signed project ruckman Dodson on a two-year extension to the end of 2028 (alongside Stocker and O'Connell on one-year deals). Page dated 11 Sep 2026. Drafted by St Kilda at pick 53 in the 2024 national draft; no trade, delisting or retirement found.

events.name: Louis Emmett
events.reporter: Western Bulldogs (draft selection); Zero Hanger and Footywire (contract end 2027)
events.note: Original draft contract, kept as the anchor because no re-signing was found. Drafted by the Bulldogs at pick 27 in the 2025 National Draft from the Oakleigh Chargers. The draft date is approximate. Zero Hanger (https://www.zerohanger.com/afl/players/louis-emmett/) lists him as contracted until 2027. Footywire (https://www.footywire.com/afl/footy/pp-western-bulldogs--louis-emmett) says out of contract at the end of 2027, and its Bulldogs contracts list (https://www.footywire.com/afl/footy/to-western-bulldogs) gives 2 years of service. The 2-year length follows from those two figures. No extension, trade or delisting was found. Searching stopped early because the web search budget ran out.

events.name: Charlie Edwards
events.note: Extended alongside Borlase, Bond and Ryan after his first season at West Lakes (2023 draft, pick 21), through the end of 2026. Club page carries no visible date; 13 Sept 2024 date taken from BigFooty's repost (https://www.bigfooty.com/2024/09/young-crows-extend-contracts-borlase-bond-edwards-and-ryan-sign-on/) and Zero Hanger's 'Quartet of Crows extend time at West Lakes' (13 Sept 2024). Length of 2 is inferred from the end year.

events.name: Charlie Edwards
events.note: One-year extension (with Mitchell Hinge, Oscar Ryan, Billy Dowling) published 29 Sept 2026. Article does not state the end year explicitly, but it is a one-year deal from a 2026 expiry, so 2027. Zero Hanger player page lists him contracted until 2027. No official club release found. No trades or delistings found; he has only played for Adelaide.

events.name: Zane Peucker
events.note: Drafted by Richmond at national draft pick 31 (from Woodville-West Torrens, SANFL); original draft contract, never re-signed. Richmond player page and Zero Hanger both show contracted until 2027 (Footywire shows final contract year 2027, 2 years of service). Draft listing: https://www.richmondfc.com.au/news/1911353/ins-and-outs-richmonds-2026-afl-list-changes. Debuted R18 2026 vs Melbourne. Not named in Richmond's October 2026 delistings (Zero Hanger roundup, AFL.com.au Green/Hayes-Brown article). Exact draft-night date estimated.

events.name: Xavier Taylor
events.note: Drafted at pick 11 in the 2025 AFL National Draft (first round held 19 Nov 2025) from Eastern Ranges. He has not re-signed, so this draft contract is the anchor. The 2028 end year comes from a Footyinfo player profile (https://www.footyinfo.com/player/xavier-taylor) seen only as a search-result summary, because the page returned 403 on fetch. The 3-year length is inferred from that end year. The club page confirms pick 11 but gives no contract length. Debuted Round 6, 2026 and played 3 games in 2026. No delisting, trade or retirement found. An AFL.com.au 2027 best-23 piece lists him among Melbourne's emergencies.

events.name: Reef McInnes
events.note: Two-year extension to the end of 2024, signed shortly after his 2022 debut (SEN archive copy dated 6 April 2022). Drafted by Collingwood at pick 23 in the 2020 national draft via the academy.

events.name: Reef McInnes
events.note: One-year deal to the end of 2025 in the club's October 2024 list update, alongside Dean, Long and Sullivan. The article page shows no date; 29 Oct 2024 comes from an X post on the same update (Mattys123, status 1851148211106541924).

events.name: Reef McInnes
events.note: Two-year extension to the end of 2027, announced with Ned Long and Tew Jiath after his Round 2 2025 ACL injury (Zero Hanger article dated 28 March 2025). Zero Hanger and Footywire still show him contracted to 2027. He played no 2026 games and I found no report of a delisting, retirement or trade, so this stays the active deal.

events.name: Taylor Goad
events.note: North Melbourne announced a two-year extension keeping Goad at the club until at least the end of 2028. The article has no visible publication date. It describes him as 19, with no senior game and 18 reserves games in his first season, so it was most likely published in the second half of 2024; the date is an estimate. Goad is not on the SEN 2026 trade hub delistings list for North Melbourne (last updated 26 Oct 2026). footyinfo also lists him under contract through 2028. No trade, delisting or retirement found.

events.name: Callum Coleman-Jones
events.note: Recommitted to Richmond until the end of 2021 before making his AFL debut (pick 20, 2017 draft). Two-year term per Wikipedia's citation of this article; article itself states only the 2021 expiry.

events.name: Callum Coleman-Jones
events.note: Traded from Richmond to North Melbourne for Robbie Tarrant swap: NM received Coleman-Jones, picks 42, 47 and a future fourth; Richmond received Tarrant, pick 40 and a future second. Trade lodged 8 Oct 2021.

events.name: Callum Coleman-Jones
events.note: Four-year deal on arrival at North Melbourne. SEN says it runs 'through 2026' but later club coverage shows the 2025 extension covered 2026, so the original deal is taken to end 2025.

events.name: Callum Coleman-Jones
events.note: One-year extension through 2026 (announced alongside Zac Banch). Club article is undated; date from AFLRATINGS player news page entry dated 23 Sep 2025: https://aflratings.com.au/afl-news-callum-coleman-jones/

events.name: Callum Coleman-Jones
events.note: North Melbourne told him he will not be offered a 2027 contract (with Bailey Scott, Robert Hansen jnr, Brayden George); 28 games for NM. Date from Zero Hanger (28 Aug 2026) https://www.zerohanger.com/north-melbourne-confirm-four-departures-including-father-son-former-tiger-181922/ and AFLRATINGS. AFL.com.au: https://www.afl.com.au/news/1596209/father-son-recruit-bailey-scott-among-four-north-melbourne-kangaroos-axed. No pickup by another club found, so no event is current. I could not run further searches (search budget exhausted) to check for a post-delisting signing.

events.name: Oliver Hannaford
events.note: Anchor: original draft deal. Selected by GWS with pick 18 in the 2024 AFL Draft (draft date approximate; article carries no date). No re-signing, extension, trade, delisting or retirement found in any source (GWS, Zero Hanger, Wikipedia, AFLRATINGS); contract length and expiry not published. Still on the GWS list page and played 5 AFL games in 2026 (debut R3), so treated as active; no 2026 off-season delisting found, but web search budget ran out before checking late-October list-change reports, so this is unconfirmed.

events.name: Harrison Oliver
events.note: Original draft deal: GWS selected him at pick 19 in the 2024 AFL National Draft (AFLRATINGS dates this 20 Nov 2024; club recap https://www.gwsgiants.com.au/news/1695047/2024-draft-night-one-recap). No re-signing, extension, trade or delisting found. Contract length and end year are not published in any source I could find. He debuted in round 10, 2026 and is not among GWS's listed 2026 off-season outs (SEN trade hub, updated 26 Oct 2026), so the draft deal is treated as the active contract. Web search budget ran out before every angle (Zero Hanger, AFL.com.au contract pages, club announcements) could be tried.

events.name: Jackson Archer
events.note: One-year extension after strong pre-season, tying him to NM until at least end of 2024 (Zero Hanger, 31 Mar 2023). Also reported by nmfc.com.au 'Son of a gun signs on' (https://www.nmfc.com.au/news/1294874/son-of-a-gun-signs-on). Original draft deal (2021 father-son, pick 59) omitted.

events.name: Jackson Archer
events.note: Two-year extension to end of 2026 (club article 'Archer becomes latest Roo to re-sign', undated on page; written mid-2024 after he played 11 of 12 games). Date estimated: AAP's Zurhaar five-year-deal report (30 Jul 2024, https://aapnews.aap.com.au/news/clarkson-kangas-buoyed-by-zurhaar-s-free-agency-call) says Archer signed a two-year deal 'this week'; Wikipedia also places it July 2024.

events.name: Jackson Archer
events.note: Two-year deal to at least end of 2028, signed while rehabbing a Jan 2026 ACL rupture that ruled him out of 2026 (Seven News reported talks began 25 Feb 2026). Club article has no visible date; exact date unconfirmed, estimated from article ID ordering and the Feb 2026 talks report. Still on NM list; no retirement/delisting found.

events.name: Matt Whitlock
events.reporter: North Melbourne Independent Tribune (NIT); also NMFC 'Two young Roos extend'
events.note: Drafted by North Melbourne with pick 27 in the 2024 AFL Draft (original mandatory deal skipped since he has since re-signed). Re-signed in the week of 3 May 2025 alongside Robert Hansen jnr; NIT reports he will stay 'until at least the end of 2027'. The contract length was not stated, so length is null. Date is the NIT article publication date (the deal was reported as 'this week'). No trade, delisting or retirement was found: North Melbourne's 2026 list-change announcement (nmfc.com.au/news/2113892) names only Scott, Coleman-Jones, Hansen jnr and George, not Whitlock. Web search budget was exhausted, so only a Wikipedia page, the NMFC player page, the NIT article and the NMFC list-changes article were read directly. Not independently checked against AFL.com.au or Zero Hanger.

events.name: Luker Kentfield
events.note: One-year extension through 2027 (Melbourne list manager Tim Lamb quoted). Announcement reportedly June 25, 2026 per an AFLRATINGS Trade GM post; the article is dated June 29. His only re-signing on record, so it is the anchor. Web search budget was exhausted, so the delisting check relied on a Melbourne squad page that still showed the 2026 list; no delisting or trade evidence was found and none is asserted.

events.name: Andy Moniz-Wakefield
events.note: AFLRATINGS player news logs a one-year contract extension via Melbourne on 13 Sep 2024. End year 2025 is inferred from the one-year length. He was a 2021 Category B rookie (NGA, Nightcliff), so the original draft deal is skipped.

events.name: Andy Moniz-Wakefield
events.note: Melbourne FC 'Demon trio sign on' says he re-signed with Jai Culley and Ricky Mentha Jnr as a rookie for 2026. The page shows no date, so the date is estimated to around the end of the 2025 season. Length and end year are inferred from 'for next season'; the club page does not state them. AFLRATINGS does not list this signing.

events.name: Andy Moniz-Wakefield
events.note: AFLRATINGS lists him as delisted by Melbourne in its 2026 retirements and delistings page. Its player news page dates the delisting 2 Sep 2026. He ruptured his ACL again on 1 Jun 2026 (https://aflratings.com.au/2026/06/02/injury-update-andy-moniz-wakefield-2/). No club or AFL.com.au confirmation was fetched, because the web search budget ran out. No event is current.

events.name: Josh Gibcus
events.note: Richmond announced two-year extensions for Gibcus, Jack Ross and Maurice Rioli Jr; AFLRATINGS states Gibcus is contracted until the end of 2025 (Ross/Rioli to 2024). Drafted by Richmond at pick 9 in the 2021 national draft, so this is his first re-signing.

events.name: Josh Gibcus
events.note: One-year extension announced by Richmond (AFLRATINGS player news logs it on 13 Aug 2024, post dated 14 Aug) while rehabbing his ACL, taking him to the end of 2026. Flagged current as the last confirmed deal: Richmond's 2027 list-changes page (updated 16 Oct 2026) does not list Gibcus among retirements, non-offers or delistings, and no 2026 re-signing was found. His 2027 contract status is unconfirmed (he ruptured/sprained his ACL again in May 2026 and missed the rest of the season). Web search budget was exhausted, so only direct page fetches were used.

events.name: Jamarra Ugle-Hagan
events.note: Two-year extension from end of 2022 to end of 2024 (GM Sam Power: 'locked in until the end of 2024'). Date 5 Aug 2021 per standard.net.au report https://www.standard.net.au/story/7373628/staying-put-jamarra-signs-two-year-extension-with-bulldogs/ ; club page https://www.westernbulldogs.com.au/news/994251/two-more-for-ugle-hagan

events.name: Jamarra Ugle-Hagan
events.note: New two-year deal to end of 2026, per AFLRATINGS citing Sam Edmund. Bulldogs later confirmed he was still under contract for 2026 at time of trade.

events.name: Jamarra Ugle-Hagan
events.note: Traded Western Bulldogs to Gold Coast on trade deadline day for pick 74 (round 4, 2025 draft). He sat out all of 2025 for personal reasons. Also AFL.com.au https://www.afl.com.au/news/1442065/jamarra-ugle-hagan-gets-second-chance-as-gold-coast-suns-complete-trade-with-western-bulldogs/amp and AFLRATINGS https://aflratings.com.au/2025/10/15/jamarra-ugle-hagan-joins-gold-coast/

events.name: Jamarra Ugle-Hagan
events.note: One-year deal (reportedly ~$250k) with a games trigger for a second year; end year 2026 inferred from one-year term. He played 3 games in 2026 and did not reach the trigger (Zero Hanger 21 Aug 2026: https://www.zerohanger.com/gold-coast-comments-on-star-pies-links-ugle-hagans-future-181565/). As of 13 Oct 2026 Zero Hanger reported his 2027 contract unresolved, in 'negotiation phase' (https://www.zerohanger.com/gold-coast-suns-yet-to-resolve-former-pick-1s-2027-contract-183797/); a one-year 2027 deal with incentives was reported as imminent on 28 Sep 2026 (https://www.zerohanger.com/jamarra-ugle-hagans-next-step-revealed-183237/) and 14 Sep 2026 (https://nit.com.au/14-09-2026/26447/ugle-hagan-closing-in-on-new-deal-as-rioli-set-to-stay-at-richmond). No signed 2027 deal, delisting or retirement could be confirmed as of 27 Oct 2026 (web search budget exhausted), so this remains the last confirmed deal and is marked current; a follow-up check is recommended.

events.name: Jed Adams
events.note: Two-year extension through end of 2026 (List Manager Tim Lamb quoted). AFLRATINGS post dated 2024-03-20; its player hub lists the item as 2024-03-19. Melbourne's Bailey Laurie extension article says it follows the Sparrow and Adams re-signings earlier in the month. Drafted 2022 (pick 38), 0 senior games in 2026 (PCL surgery July 2026). No later re-signing, delisting or retirement found: he is absent from AFLRATINGS' 2026 retirements/delistings list (Melbourne: retired May, Campbell, McAdam, McDonald, Melksham; delisted Henderson, Johnson, Moniz-Wakefield, Onley, White; traded Rivers, Viney). The deal runs out at the end of 2026 and no 2027 extension was confirmed, so treat his status as unconfirmed. Web search budget was exhausted, so club-site and AFL.com.au confirmation could not be run.

events.name: Finlay Macrae
events.note: Signed a two-year contract extension with Collingwood to the end of 2024 (AFLRATINGS contract update dated 6 July 2022).

events.name: Finlay Macrae
events.note: One-year extension keeping him at Collingwood until the end of 2025, announced alongside Patrick Lipinski and Darcy Cameron (Collingwood FC: https://www.collingwoodfc.com.au/news/1503735/pies-lock-in-trio). Date is the AFLRATINGS publication date; the club article is undated.

events.name: Finlay Macrae
events.note: Delisted by Collingwood with Oleg Markov, Ash Johnson and Charlie Dean after the 2025 finals exit; not offered a 2026 contract. Date per Wikipedia citation of the AFL Media article (23 Sep 2025); the article page itself shows no date.

events.name: Finlay Macrae
events.note: Signed by West Coast on the opening day of the Supplemental Selection Period (with Deven Robertson and Harry Schoenberg). Contract length/end year not disclosed in any source found. Corroborated by https://aflratings.com.au/2025/11/25/finlay-macrae-joins-west-coast/. No 2026 extension, delisting or retirement for Macrae was found in AFLRATINGS' 2026 trade news hub through mid-October 2026, so this is treated as the active deal; the hub was only partly readable and the web search tool was unavailable (budget exhausted), so a late-2026 re-signing or delisting cannot be ruled out.

events.name: Jay Polkinghorne
events.note: Geelong's 'Edwards and young quartet commit to the Hoops' article says Polkinghorne (pick 44, 2024 national draft) recommitted for the 2027 season, alongside Hofmann, Burke and Driscoll. Length of 1 year is inferred from the 2027 end year (the article states no length). The article page shows no publish date. The date is taken from the club's 'Young Group Sign On | Highlights' video (https://www.geelongcats.com.au/video/2069447/young-group-sign-on-highlights), timestamped 14 July 2026, so it is marked estimated. Our existing data dates the same article's Edwards extension 15 July. He debuted in round 19, 2026. No delisting, trade or retirement found: Geelong's post-season list update names only Mitch Knevitt as not offered a contract, so this is the active deal. His original draft contract is not returned because he has re-signed.

events.name: Noah Howes
events.note: Re-signed on a one-year deal for 2026 alongside Lachlan Sullivan after joining via the 2025 mid-season draft (28 May 2025, pick 15 per AFLRATINGS). Date 21 Oct 2025 per AFLRATINGS and our existing Sullivan record. The original mid-season draft contract is omitted because he re-signed.

events.name: Noah Howes
events.note: Collingwood announced on 21 Oct 2026 that Howes (with Harrison Coe) was not offered a new contract and was delisted after two AFL games. The club said it remains open to considering him in the national or rookie drafts (rookie draft 21 Nov 2026). Also reported by AFL.com.au and AFLRATINGS. No later signing was found, so no event is current.

events.name: Lukas Cooke
events.note: Rookie-list one-year extension to end of 2027, alongside Joel Fitzgerald and Max Mapley. Date is the article's datePublished metadata (2026-08-07). Original mid-season draft deal (pick 11, 26 May 2026, from Woodville-West Torrens, six-month term to end of 2026 per AFL.com.au Inside Trading) skipped as he has re-signed. Not on Melbourne's 2026 delisted or retired lists found.

events.name: Archie Ludowyke
events.note: Club announced one-year extension (with Mitchell Marsh) keeping him at the Crows until at least end of 2028; page datePublished 2026-06-01. Zero Hanger profile also lists contract to 2028. Drafted pick 50 in the 2025 National Draft (original draft deal skipped as he has re-signed). Not among Adelaide's 2026 delistings (Chayce Jones, Lachie Sholl, Tyler Welsh) found.

events.name: Lucca Grego
events.reporter: Zero Hanger / West Coast Eagles / Albany Advertiser
events.note: One-year extension added to original 2-year 2024 draft deal (pick 48), through end of 2027. Zero Hanger article dated 19 June 2025; Albany Advertiser (19 June 2025) and club page https://www.westcoasteagles.com.au/news/1808198/young-trio-recommit-at-eagles corroborate. Not named in 2026 delisting reports (Zero Hanger 16 Oct 2026 https://www.zerohanger.com/west-coast-make-trio-of-list-cullings-183973/), so still contracted for 2027.

events.name: Mitch Podhajski
events.note: Selected from Coburg (VFL) in the 2026 Mid-Season Rookie Draft (pick 18 overall per SEN/Wikipedia; the club site labels it pick 17) after Jamie Elliott's knee injury opened a list spot. Club article describes a six-month contract (about 12 potential games); the draft date of 26 May 2026 comes from Wikipedia and SEN, not the club page. He never re-signed, so the draft deal is kept as the anchor. Draft date also at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_AFL_draft and https://sen.com.au/news/2026/05/26/afl-mid-season-draft-2026-live-order-nominees-every-pick-club-by-club

events.name: Mitch Podhajski
events.note: Collingwood confirmed he would not be offered a 2027 contract, along with Cochran, Parker, Ryan, Smit and Sullivan, after the Wildcard Round loss to the Western Bulldogs. He played 2 AFL games and 7 VFL games (20 goals). The club page shows no date; 1 Sep 2026 is the Zero Hanger publication date (https://www.zerohanger.com/collingwood-delists-untried-defender-ssp-midfielder-among-six-names-182088/). Also reported at https://www.afl.com.au/news/1600213/ex-cricketer-and-mid-season-rookie-among-six-collingwood-magpies-delisted. No later club found, so no event is current.

events.name: Oscar Berry
events.note: Signed as a Category B rookie (college basketballer, University of North Florida) for the 2026 season on a two-year deal. Club statement (melbournefc.com.au/news/1923491) says 'at least the next two seasons'. Footywire and Zero Hanger both list the contract running to the end of 2027. Exact announcement date is not shown on the article; the Demonland forum thread dates the AFL.com.au report to about 1 July 2025 (Zero Hanger copy stamped 30 Oct 2025). No re-signing, extension, trade, delisting or retirement found: he is not among Melbourne's five 2026 delistings (White, Henderson, Johnson, Moniz-Wakefield, Onley) or five retirements (Campbell, May, McAdam, T. McDonald, Melksham) in AFL.com.au's list-changes report (afl.com.au/news/1600513). Original draft deal retained as anchor because he has never re-signed.

events.name: Lewis Hayes
events.note: Two-year extension to end of 2026 after initial 2-year draft deal (pick 25, 2022). Club article has no visible date; 24 July 2024 per Wikipedia's citation of it.

events.name: Lewis Hayes
events.note: One-year extension to end of 2027 (club headline 'Hayes signs on until 2027'). Page shows no date; 21 May 2026 per Wikipedia's citation. Re-injured ACL in VFL return (June 2026). Not on any 2026 Essendon delisting list found (AFL.com.au/SEN).

events.name: Billy Cootee
events.note: Anchor deal (never re-signed): drafted by Sydney at pick 42 (round 3, night two of the 2025 AFL National Draft, 20 Nov 2025; mature-age selection from Norwood, SANFL). Footywire lists him out of contract at end of 2027 and Zero Hanger shows contracted until 2027. Length of 2 is inferred from the 2025 and 2027 end year (standard two-year draft deal), and the exact signing date is the draft night, not a confirmed signing announcement. No extension, trade or delisting found as of late Oct 2026. Draft date from AFL.com.au night-two coverage (https://www.afl.com.au/news/1455116); contract end corroborated by https://www.zerohanger.com/afl/players/billy-cootee/

events.name: Caleb Lewis
events.reporter: Gold Coast FC (goldcoastfc.com.au); date per AFLRATINGS
events.note: Club announced Caleb Lewis and Jy Farrar both extended through the end of the 2027 season (the club page itself is undated). AFLRATINGS (https://aflratings.com.au/afl-news-caleb-lewis/) dates it 1 July 2026 and calls it a one-year extension. Lewis was a 2025 mid-season rookie draft pick (#14, Gold Coast) and debuted in round 19, 2026. Conflict: Footywire and Zero Hanger list him contracted to 2028; no source found for a further extension, so the club-confirmed 2027 end is used. No delisting, retirement or trade found as of late Oct 2026.

events.name: Caleb Graham
events.note: Re-signed with Brodie, MacPherson and McLennan to end of 2022 (club and AFL.com.au confirm 'until 2022'). Exact date 14 Aug 2019 comes from a search-result snippet; Wikipedia says August 2019. Length (3) inferred from 2020-2022. Corroborated: https://www.afl.com.au/news/129402/tough-top-10-pick-among-four-young-suns-to-ink-new-deals

events.name: Caleb Graham
events.note: Four-year extension to end of 2026 (club article; also AFLRATINGS https://aflratings.com.au/2022/08/11/contract-update-caleb-graham/). Date from AFLRATINGS entry in our data; club page shows no date.

events.name: Caleb Graham
events.note: Gold Coast will not offer Graham (with Cooper Bell and Asher Eastham) a 2027 contract; delisted at end of 2026 after 37 games, none since 2022. Date 26 Aug 2026 comes from a Zero Hanger fetch and is a secondary source; club and AFL.com.au pieces carry no date. Also: https://www.goldcoastfc.com.au/news/2113248/suns-confirm-list-changes and https://www.afl.com.au/news/1595656/gold-coast-academy-graduate-among-three-suns-delisted and https://aflratings.com.au/2026-afl-retirements-and-delistings/

events.name: Elliott Himmelberg
events.note: Two-year extension to end of 2020 (AFL.com.au article carries no date; 20 March 2018 per Footywire player biography https://www.footywire.com/afl/club/player-biography/6376.html).

events.name: Elliott Himmelberg
events.note: Two-year extension dated 9 Sep 2020; end of 2022 per Footywire biography and AFL.com.au via search summary (Zero Hanger itself does not state end year). Club article: https://www.afc.com.au/news/809668/himmelberg-signs-contract-extension

events.name: Elliott Himmelberg
events.note: Two-year extension to end of 2024; club announcement https://www.afc.com.au/news/1200867/himmelberg-re-signs-with-crows (until at least 2024); Daily Advertiser first published 23 Aug 2022. A 2023 trade to GWS collapsed, he stayed for 2024.

events.name: Elliott Himmelberg
events.note: Unrestricted free agent from Adelaide to Gold Coast, three-year deal to at least end of 2027, nil compensation (club release https://www.goldcoastfc.com.au/news/1671773/suns-recruit-elliott-himmelberg; Footywire shows out of contract end of 2027). Tore ACL in 2025; no extension, delisting or retirement found as of Oct 2026.

events.name: Harry Barnett
events.reporter: West Coast Eagles (club site); corroborated by Zero Hanger
events.note: Two-year extension (2025-26) signed at the end of his rookie deal (pick 23, 2022 draft); club social post dated 14 Jun 2024. Zero Hanger: https://www.zerohanger.com/west-coast-ruckman-secures-future-151908/

events.name: Harry Barnett
events.note: West Coast delisted Barnett (with Harvey Johnston), opting not to offer a contract for 2027; article dated 25 Aug 2026. Two AFL games (2023, 2024). No signing elsewhere found. Zero Hanger: https://www.zerohanger.com/west-coast-announce-first-wave-of-delistings-181801/

events.name: James Blanck
events.note: One-year extension through the end of 2024, signed after joining via the 2022 mid-season rookie draft (pick 20) on an initial 18-month deal. Zero Hanger article dated 12 July 2023. Club review corroborates: https://www.hawthornfc.com.au/news/1434940/2023-in-summary-james-blanck

events.name: James Blanck
events.note: Two-year extension to end of 2026, announced by Sam Mitchell at the Torquay pre-season camp (Monday night); Zero Hanger published 30 Jan 2024. AFL.com.au corroborates: https://www.afl.com.au/news/1073982/hawthorn-hawks-sign-defender-james-blanck-to-two-year-contract-extension-after-joining-from-box-hill-in-mid-season-draft and Footywire lists 30 Jan 2024. The AFL.com.au copy also says 'next three seasons' but states end of 2026.

events.name: James Blanck
events.note: Hawthorn delisted Blanck (with Hustwaite, Ryan, Anderson, Uhr-Henry); not offered a 2027 contract. Zero Hanger published 24 Sep 2026. AFL.com.au corroborates: https://www.afl.com.au/news/1620090/hawthorn-hawks-confirm-five-departures-as-off-season-list-changes-begin. No new club found as at late Oct 2026, so no event is current.

events.name: Jakob Ryan
events.note: Signed a two-year extension alongside John Noble and Beau McCreery, keeping him at Collingwood until at least the end of 2026. The club page has no visible date; 23 July 2023 comes from the AFLRATINGS news item (https://aflratings.com.au/afl-news-jakob-ryan/), and our local contracts_manual note also places the announcement in July 2023.

events.name: Jakob Ryan
events.note: Collingwood confirmed six list changes after the 2026 season. Ryan, Joel Cochran, Wil Parker, Mitch Podhajski, Iliro Smit and Lachie Sullivan will not be offered contracts for 2027. The club page shows no date; 1 September 2026 comes from the Wikipedia citation and AFLRATINGS. No sign of a new club or contract elsewhere, so no event is current.

events.name: Ivan Soldo
events.note: Soldo and Mabior Chol re-committed for two more years to 2021. Article undated; context (2019 qualifying final vs Brisbane) points to Sept 2019.

events.name: Ivan Soldo
events.note: Three-year deal to end of 2024 after missing the 2021 season with a knee injury. Date from SEN/Zero Hanger coverage of 17 Sept 2021.

events.name: Ivan Soldo
events.note: Traded from Richmond to Port Adelaide on 18 Oct 2023; Richmond received picks 41 and 49, a future second-round pick (Fremantle) and Port's future fourth-round pick.

events.name: Ivan Soldo
events.note: Three-year contract at Port on arrival; Sept 2024 report calls him one year into a three-year deal (implies end of 2026; Zero Hanger profile also shows contracted until 2026). Signing date assumed to match trade date. Trade request to St Kilda in Sept 2024 fell through.

events.name: Ivan Soldo
events.note: Retired effective immediately after rupturing his ACL in Feb 2026 (66 games, 2019 premiership). Date from BD Times report timestamp (bdtimes.com.au/sport/afl/injured-port-adelaide-ruck-ivan-soldo-announces-retirement-effective-immediately-c-22197947). Listed as retired in Zero Hanger's 2026 retirements/delistings.

events.name: Tyler Welsh
events.note: Article dated 30 Oct 2025 says Adelaide delisted the father-son forward (pick 59, 2024 draft) 'on the Friday' while finalising its list, with a promise to reselect him in the rookie draft. Date inferred as the preceding Friday, 24 Oct 2025.

events.name: Tyler Welsh
events.note: Re-rookied by Adelaide with pick 11 in Round 1 of the 2025 Rookie Draft (21 Nov 2025). Contract length not published; end year inferred from the 2026 delisting. Replaces his original 2024 pick-59 draft contract.

events.name: Tyler Welsh
events.note: Delisted by Adelaide after the semi-final loss to Brisbane, with Chayce Jones and Lachie Sholl; not offered a contract for 2027. 27 SANFL games, no AFL games. Zero Hanger also reported it (https://www.zerohanger.com/adelaide-announces-delistings-former-pick-9-crow-cut-182798/). No later club found, so no event is current.

events.name: Benny Barrett
events.note: Category B rookie (signed end of 2024) extended with Jacob Moss for another 12 months; Port Adelaide FC (https://www.portadelaidefc.com.au/news/1877529/cat-b-rookie-duo-extended) says contract runs until end of 2026. Date from Zero Hanger article (28 Aug 2025). Original 2024 Cat B rookie contract skipped since he re-signed.

events.name: Benny Barrett
events.reporter: Zero Hanger / Port Adelaide FC / AFL.com.au
events.note: Port Adelaide told Barrett (with Jackson Mead, Will Lorenz, Mani Liddy, Xavier Walsh, Jacob Moss) he would not be offered a 2027 contract; no AFL games in two seasons. Also at https://www.portadelaidefc.com.au/news/2112434/port-adelaide-farewells-six and https://www.afl.com.au/news/1595158/port-adelaide-power-axe-six-players-as-off-season-of-change-looms. No rookie selection or new club found as of late Oct 2026, so no event is current.

events.name: Campbell Lake
events.note: Selected at pick 7 in the 2026 AFL Mid-Season Rookie Draft (26 May 2026) from Southport (VFL); nominated a 6-month deal but St Kilda gave him 18 months, through to the end of 2027. Zero Hanger also lists contract until 2027. Never re-signed (no extension, delisting or retirement found as of late Oct 2026; not among the 2026 St Kilda delistings of Dow, Keeler, Said). Original mandatory rookie deal returned as the anchor.

events.name: William McCabe
events.note: Father-son (pick 19, 2023) re-signed with Hawthorn alongside Calsher Dear. Club says 'until at least the end of 2027'; Zero Hanger (2 Oct 2026) calls it a one-year extension. Club article is undated; date taken from Zero Hanger's 2 Oct 2026 publication and Dear's same-day re-signing, so treated as estimated.

events.name: Toby Conway
events.note: Re-signed in July 2022 batch with Holmes, O'Connor, Dempsey and Neale; deal listed to end of 2025. Page returned 403 to direct fetch; detail taken from search-result summary of the article. Contract length not stated.

events.name: Toby Conway
events.reporter: K ROCK 95.5 (Geelong Cats club announcement 'Conway Commits')
events.note: Two-year extension to at least end of 2027, published 21 March 2025. Corroborated by Geelong club announcement https://www.geelongcats.com.au/news/1735649/tc-announcement and Zero Hanger profile (Contracted Until 2027). Not in Geelong's 2026 delisting/retirement/trade lists (SEN list-changes roundup), so deal remains active.

events.name: Jaren Carr
events.note: Original draft contract only (never re-signed). Father-son selection at pick 63 in the 2024 National Draft, byline dated 21 Nov 2024. Contract length is not stated in any source found; 2 years is inferred from the draft date and the end year of 2026 shown on Zero Hanger (https://www.zerohanger.com/afl/players/jaren-carr/) and Footyinfo. As of 21-26 Oct 2026 Zero Hanger (https://www.zerohanger.com/the-29-players-left-in-afl-limbo-following-the-trade-period-183734/) lists him as Fremantle's only player without a 2027 contract. AFL.com.au (https://www.afl.com.au/news/1625941/sean-darcy-not-on-trade-table-but-fremantle-dockers-midfielder-nathan-odriscoll-set-to-leave) says the Dockers have committed to him for 2027, with rookie or senior list undecided until after the trade and draft periods. He was not delisted, and no re-signing was found as of 27 Oct 2026.

events.name: Flynn Perez
events.note: One-year extension through 2022 (also nmfc.com.au/news/849172/flynn-perez-extends: 'until at least the end of 2022'). Article dated 14 Jan 2021.

events.name: Flynn Perez
events.note: North Melbourne re-signed Perez and Lachie Young for 2023. Club page has no date or length; date approximated from September 2022 timing (Dandenong Star 2022-09-16 'former rays ink extensions'), 1-year/2023 end inferred.

events.name: Flynn Perez
events.note: Delisted by North Melbourne with Lachie Young, Phoenix Spicer and Jacob Edwards; not offered a 2024 contract. Played 24 AFL games for NM. Then Sturt (SANFL) 2024-25.

events.name: Flynn Perez
events.note: Signed via 2026 pre-season supplemental selection period onto Hawthorn's rookie list for 2026 (SSP signing deadline Mon 2 Mar 2026). Zero Hanger lists 'Contracted Until 2026'. Played 7 games.

events.name: Flynn Perez
events.note: Hawthorn delisted Perez and Max Ramsden, no 2027 contract offered; both invited to train on in the 2027 pre-season SSP (see also hawthornfc.com.au/news/2152155/hawks-farewell-pair). No active deal, so no current event.
